nodes.label: libuv Async Notification

nodes.label: Event Loop Phases

nodes.label: Microtasks and nextTick
nodes.description: process.nextTick() and Promise callbacks execute between phases; recursive nextTick starves I/O

nodes.label: nextTick Starvation
nodes.description: Recursive process.nextTick prevents I/O callbacks from executing; use setImmediate for recursion instead

nodes.label: Thread Pool Starvation

nodes.label: Streams Architecture
nodes.description: Four-layer architecture: JS (Readable/Writable/Duplex/Transform) -> C++ (StreamBase, StreamReq) -> libuv streams (uv_stream_t) -> system

nodes.label: StreamBase C++ Interface
nodes.description: StreamBase abstract class: ReadStart/ReadStop/DoWrite/DoShutdown; WriteWrap/ShutdownWrap for operation tracking

nodes.label: Readable Stream Flow
nodes.description: read() -> _read(n) -> C++ ReadStart -> uv_read_start -> epoll/kqueue -> alloc_cb -> read_cb -> OnRead -> Buffer -> push(chunk) -> data event

nodes.label: V8 Generational GC
nodes.description: Generational GC: Scavenger (young gen, semi-space copying) + Mark-Sweep/Mark-Compact (old gen); based on generational hypothesis

nodes.label: V8 Scavenger (Minor GC)
nodes.description: Young generation collection: semi-space copying, objects surviving 2 collections promoted to old space; fast but requires 2x memory

nodes.label: Mark-Sweep (Major GC)
nodes.description: Old generation: mark reachable objects from roots, sweep dead; incremental marking reduces pause times; write barriers track cross-gen refs

nodes.label: Mark-Compact GC
nodes.description: When heap fragmentation is high: mark + compact by moving live objects to eliminate gaps; expensive due to pointer updates

nodes.label: GC Common Pitfalls
nodes.description: Closure memory retention, unintentional global references, timer/event listener leaks; use object pooling for high-allocation scenarios

nodes.label: V8 Hidden Classes (Maps)
nodes.description: V8 creates hidden classes describing object structure; transitions happen on property add/delete; maps describe property offsets

nodes.label: Inline Caching (IC)
nodes.description: V8 caches hidden class and offset for property access; states: uninitialized -> monomorphic -> polymorphic -> megamorphic (>4 maps)

nodes.label: Array Elements Kinds
nodes.description: V8 tracks array element types: PACKED_SMI_ELEMENTS (fastest) -> PACKED_DOUBLE_ELEMENTS -> PACKED_ELEMENTS -> HOLEY_ELEMENTS; transitions only downward

nodes.label: Hidden Class Best Practices
nodes.description: Initialize properties in consistent order, use classes/constructors, avoid delete, keep type stability, avoid dynamic property names

nodes.label: V8 JIT Compilation Pipeline
nodes.description: Parser -> AST -> Ignition (interpreter, bytecode) -> TurboFan (JIT compiler, machine code); profiling triggers tier-up

nodes.label: Type Feedback and Speculation
nodes.description: TurboFan uses type feedback to speculate on types; deoptimization occurs on type mismatch (not a Smi, wrong map, etc.)

nodes.label: Writing Optimizable Code
nodes.description: Type stability, avoid megamorphic call sites, loop optimization, avoid arguments object, prefer rest parameters, avoid object spread in hot loops

nodes.label: V8 Escape Analysis
nodes.description: TurboFan eliminates heap allocations when objects don't escape the function; enables stack allocation

nodes.label: Worker Threads Architecture
nodes.description: Each worker has its own V8 Isolate and event loop; communication via MessagePort/MessageChannel; shared memory via SharedArrayBuffer

nodes.label: Worker Thread Creation
nodes.description: JS Worker class creates C++ WorkerImpl, sets up MessageChannel, StartThread creates uv_thread with new V8 Isolate and Environment

nodes.label: Structured Clone for Messaging
nodes.description: Messages serialized via structured clone: supports numbers, strings, Date, RegExp, Array, Map, Set, Buffer, TypedArray, ArrayBuffer, Error; not functions/symbols

nodes.label: Transfer List (Zero-Copy)
nodes.description: Transfer ArrayBuffer/MessagePort ownership instead of copying; transferred buffer is detached (unusable) in sender
